# 2 bed apartment for sale

> No. 41 Trimbleston is a most attractive, second floor apartment located in front of the development in the Sycamore block. Trimbleston is a prestigious, Sorahan-built development off the Goatstown Road, considered a most desirable location in south Dublin. This modern development comprises a lovely blend of apartments and houses set amidst landscaped gardens.

- Typ: apartment
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 2 bed
- Plocha: 78 m²
- Energetická náročnost: B
- Lokalita: 41 Trimbelston, Goatstown
- Cena: 585 000 €
